summary: NEMA 6 to 42 stepper motor by frame size (a number), face at z = 0, shaft up, body down.

options.shaft_len: shaft length above the face in mm (default 20)
options.details: false for a rough block suitable as a mask
options.anchor: attachment anchor (default TOP of the body)
